# Sodium Liquid-Metal Architecture

| System               | State                                 |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Na(s)                | metallic crystal                      |
| Na(l)                | conducting fluid                      |
| NaK                  | liquid alloy family                   |
| electromagnetic pump | J × B coupling                        |
| coolant system       | convective + conductive heat transfer |
